**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/ScreenTypes.cs`

Tracks in-game and pre-game screens, active stash tabs, and conflict-free managed auto-flow toolbar slots with automatic re-attachment across area transitions and `LeagueOverlay::Fill` rebuilds.

```csharp
public interface IScreensService
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |

| Event | Summary |
|---|---|

| `event Action<ActiveStashTabChangedEventArgs>? ActiveStashTabChanged` | Raised on the game thread when the active stash tab or map sub-tab changes. |

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|

| `ILeagueModeRegistration RegisterLeagueCardMode(LeagueModeCheckboxOptions options, Action<string, bool>? onChanged = null)` | Registers a mode checkbox into `LeagueCardModes` that is automatically re-injected into every `0xdc35` card's mode `StackLayout` on `LeagueOverlay::Fill`, equalizing widths with HC/SSF/Ruthless and compacting height/spacing within the `500×905` card budget. |
| `ISlotAttachment AttachToControl(nint parentHandle, string virtualUiPath, string? id = null, float x = 0f, float y = 0f)` | Low-level escape hatch attaching a `.ui` layout directly under an arbitrary native `UI::Control*` handle. |
| `IReadOnlyList<ISlotAttachment> GetSlotAttachments(ScreenSlot slot)` | Returns all registered attachments currently ordered in `slot`. |

| `bool Dismiss(ulong toastId)` | Dismisses an active or queued toast immediately by id. Returns: `true` if the toast existed and was removed. |

### `IUiControl`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/UiTypes.cs`

Base abstraction for a node in the client's native `.ui` control tree.

```csharp
public interface IUiControl
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `string Id { get; }` | The control's `id` attribute (may be empty for anonymous layout controls). |
| `nint NativeHandle { get; }` | Underlying native `UI::Control*` pointer, or `Zero` when managed-only. |
| `ulong VtableAddress { get; }` | Native primary vtable address (`*(uint64_t*)NativeHandle`), or `0` if unavailable. |
| `uint Tag { get; }` | Native numeric tag at `Control+0x1d8` (for example `0xdc35` on `LeagueCard` or `0xc004` on `InventoryItemView`). |
| `string ControlType { get; }` | The control type name (for example `Frame`, `Label`, `Button`, `TextBox`, `CheckBox`). |
| `string Path { get; }` | The dotted id path of this control relative to its owning window. |
| `bool Visible { get; set; }` | Gets or sets whether the control is visible. |
| `string Text { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the control's text or caption. |
| `UiRect Rect { get; }` | Gets the control's current position and size. |
| `UiRect Bounds { get; }` | Alias for `Rect`. |
| `bool IsEnabled { get; set; }` | Gets or sets whether the control is enabled for interaction. |
| `IUiControl? Parent { get; }` | The parent control, or `null` for a window root. |
| `IReadOnlyList<IUiControl> Children { get; }` | Ordered child controls directly under this control. |
| `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Properties { get; }` | Key-value properties parsed from the `.ui` layout or set dynamically at runtime. |

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `void SetPosition(float x, float y)` | Updates the control's relative position. |
| `void SetSize(float width, float height)` | Updates the control's dimensions. |
| `void SetWidth(float width)` | Updates the control's width (native `Control::SetWidth` vtable slot 17). |
| `void SetHeight(float height)` | Updates the control's height (native `Control::SetHeight` vtable slot 18). |
| `void SetAnchor(byte xAnchor, float xOffset, byte yAnchor, float yOffset)` | Updates horizontal and vertical layout anchors and offsets (`Control+0x158..+0x164`). |
| `void SetAutoWidth(bool enabled)` | Enables or disables automatic width sizing on layout controls and checkboxes. |
| `void UpdateLayout()` | Triggers a native layout recalculation (`Layout::Update`) for this control's layout container. |
| `void AddChild(IUiControl child)` | Attaches a child control under this control. |
| `bool RemoveChild(IUiControl child)` | Detaches a child control from this control. |
| `void Destroy()` | Destroys this control, detaching it from its parent and releasing native resources. |
| `IReadOnlyList<IUiControl> GetChildren()` | Returns the live ordered child controls (enumerating native stock children at `+0xb8` when backed by a native control). |
| `string? GetProperty(string name)` | Reads a raw property value by name, or `null` if unset. |
| `void SetProperty(string name, string value)` | Sets a raw property value by name. |
| `IUiControl? Find(string idPath)` | Finds a descendant control by dotted id path (for example `body.buttons.plant`) or direct id. |
| `T? Find<T>(string idPath) where T: class, IUiControl` | Finds a descendant control by dotted id path and casts it to `T`. |
| `T Require<T>(string idPath) where T: class, IUiControl` | Finds a descendant control by dotted id path or throws `KeyNotFoundException` if absent or wrong type. |


|---|---|

### `IUiWindow`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/UiTypes.cs`

A top-level mod window loaded from a `.ui` layout file.

```csharp
public interface IUiWindow: IUiControl, IDisposable
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `string SourcePath { get; }` | The virtual game path from which this window was loaded. |
| `bool IsOpen { get; }` | Gets whether the window is currently open and attached to the UI tree. |

**Events:**

| Event | Summary |
|---|---|
| `event Action? Closed` | Raised when the window is closed. |

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `void Reload()` | Reloads this window's control tree from its `SourcePath` overlay. |
| `void Close()` | Closes and detaches this window from the UI tree. |

### `IUiService`

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk.Engine` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Sdk/Engine/UiTypes.cs`

High-level service for loading `.ui` layouts, managing mod windows, and registering custom UI control types.

```csharp
public interface IUiService
```

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyCollection<IUiWindow> OpenWindows { get; }` | Currently open mod windows. |

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `IUiControl? GetRootControl()` | Returns the live native UI root control, or `null` if unavailable. |
| `IUiControl? WrapControl(nint nativeHandle)` | Wraps a raw native `UI::Control*` handle into a live `IUiControl` node, or returns `null` for `Zero`. |
| `IUiWindow Load(string virtualPath, string? windowId = null)` | Loads a `.ui` file through the file overlay and attaches a new isolated window to the active UI root. Returns: The loaded window handle. |
| `IUiWindow CreateWindowInto(IUiControl parent, string virtualPath, string? windowId = null)` | Loads a `.ui` layout and attaches it directly as a child of `parent`. Returns: The loaded child window handle. |
| `IUiWindow? GetWindow(string windowId)` | Retrieves an open window by its identifier, or `null` if not open. |
| `bool CloseWindow(string windowId)` | Closes an open window by its identifier. Returns: `true` if the window existed and was closed. |
| `void ReloadWindow(string windowId)` | Reloads an open window from disk/overlay by its identifier. |
| `IDisposable RegisterControl<TControl>(string controlTypeName) where TControl: class, ICustomUiControl, new ()` | Registers a custom UI control type usable in `.ui` layouts. |
| `IDisposable RegisterControl(string controlTypeName, Func<ICustomUiControl> factory)` | Registers a custom UI control factory usable in `.ui` layouts. |
